say.t: The meeting room light is white, so white that every hand on the table has a rim of light.
The boss stands in front of the projector holding a pen. Its cap went missing long ago.
Future Intelligence's Series B. It's signed.

Only then does the room dare to make a sound. Someone slaps the table, someone twists open a bottle of water, someone holds a phone up at the projector. You sit by the door, furthest from the screen, and see all of it.
{bossCalls}. We're all in the same boat, and the boat just got bigger.
The partner stops you in the corridor. A stack of printed papers, highlighter all over them, the marks of someone reading and getting excited at once.
Hear me out. If this becomes a product, it has to be you. Only you can build it.
By the time she finishes, it is noon at the end of the corridor and the light is behind her. You can't see her face, only the highlighter lines, lit one by one.
The hundredth employee arrives in the afternoon. His backpack still on, he wipes his hand on his trousers before holding it out.
Hello, teacher… I mean, hello, boss…
You tell him {calledBy} is fine. He says it over to himself once, like saving a file.
The red envelope comes in the evening. The family table, two more dishes than usual.
{nick}, eat.
Halfway through dinner a red envelope is pushed against your bowl, so thick its flap won't close. You say you have money, really, you have money now.
We know, we know you have money. Our child's done well, we're celebrating. This is celebrating, not giving you money.
You put the envelope in your pocket. The pocket bulges, and you don't sit up straight for the rest of the meal.
Then the models got better every year. Something you had spent two years building, one day someone else built with one sentence.
The client said, we'll just have AI do it ourselves. Nobody did anything wrong. The price of doing this thing fell to zero.
The year before last I still thought writing SQL was a skill.
With every pivot a few more desks went empty. A hundred, seventy, fifty.
The last time in the office was an evening. The AI-native reform: the office was given up, everyone works from home.
No need to come in. I fought for that for you.
It wasn't quite a dream.
…A few years ago, more or less.
